merchant/30890.htm.text: Trader Espen: Welcome, traveler! Please take your time and peruse our items. But don't you sometimes feel our lives are meant to be more than sharp swords and cold metal? My advice is to take some time in this beautiful city to to rest your mind and body...

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30890-1.htm.text: Trader Espen: Well, what kind of item are you looking for?

merchant/30890-pk.htm.text: Trader Espen: I've sent for the guards, you should leave before they get here. I would not like to see blood spilled over this.

links.text: Show him the Pirate's Treasure Map.

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-13.html.text: Trader Espen: This Map that you discovered on Alligator Island... Doesn't it make your heart pound just looking at it? Ah, you want me to decipher it? Very well... But before I decipher the Map... first I must tell you the story of boatswain Muska, who betrayed Zaken, the great pirate. If you're go…

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-14.html.text: Trader Espen: Welcome back, brave hunter! What?! You haven't found the treasure yet? Didn't I mark the coordinates on the Map for you? Take a closer look at your Map! If you go to the coordinates I marked, you will definitely find the treasure...!

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-04.htm.text: Trader Espen: Oh Oh?! Could it be...? Is that really Muska's Map? Where did you find it? Let me buy the Map from you! It won't do you any good anyway. Why should you keep it? I'll pay you 1000 Adena for it!

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-05.htm.text: Trader Espen: Do you mean it? Are you sure you won't regret your decision? Here... Here is 1000 Adena. Ha! Finally, I have Muska's treasure Map! This is truly the chance of a lifetime. At last, Lady Luck smiled on me. I can give up my job as a trader and just enjoy being filthy rich! Let me see... …

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-06.htm.text: Trader Espen: Humph! I guess you're not as stupid as you look... Well, although it's only a part of it, it will lead you to the treasure of the great Pirate Captain Zaken... I know that you don't want to give up the Map so easily. Hey, listen! Wouldn't you like to know what kind of treasure is hidd…

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-07.htm.text: Trader Espen: Heh Heh Heh... Ah, yes, good decision. You won't regret your decision... Before I begin, let me tell you a story about the Pirate Captain Zaken and his traitorous boatswain, Muska. Listen carefully, as this information will be quite helpful to you in the future.

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-08.html.text: Trader Espen: At one time Muska was a faithful underling of Zaken. But, when Zaken's ship was anchored here in Heine, he fell in love with Fatima, a woman from Abella. Fatima seduced Muska and convinced him to betray his captain and steal the treasure. Blinded by love, Muska violated the cardinal r…

links.text: Continue to listen to the story.

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-09.html.text: Trader Espen: Unfortunately, Muska made a bad choice when he fell in love with Fatima. Her heart concealed dark tendencies... Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-10.html.text: Trader Espen: Muska was a hardened pirate as well, who greatly distrusted people... and Fatima was no exception. The treasure Map found on Muska's corpse was written in code, and no one could decipher it. When Zaken's ship ran aground on Devil's Isle and its captain and all of his crew were all kil…

links.text: Continue to listen to the story.

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-11.html.text: Trader Espen: You should thank your lucky stars for running into me. Why? Because I'm the only person in the world who can decipher this Map. I recently purchased Zaken's journal from some adventurers who had been exploring on Devil's Isle. It contained a detailed description of the method of decod…

Q00383_TreasureHunt/30890-12.html.text: Trader Espen: Hey you... Do you or don't you have the treasure Map? You must have heard the rumor that I'm a great pirate aficionado. So, are you trying to rip me off? Get lost!
